expectedRealization.rationale: The supply shock and product-price bridge are immediate; this thesis is explicitly underwritten only through a 20-trading-day base horizon and must be re-underwritten rather than carried as a long-duration compounder.

acceptableExpressionSet.rationale: Longsheng entered the event with strong 2018 earnings, had the clearest integrated m-phenylenediamine/dye exposure and disclosed a major capacity advantage; even after the sharp rerating, a stale pre-event 2019 EPS baseline implied a non-extreme multiple while the new physical price bridge was large.

changeHypothesis.summary: The Xiangshui explosion abruptly removed a meaningful m-phenylenediamine/intermediate supplier and was followed within days by a roughly doubling of quoted m-phenylenediamine prices. An unaffected integrated leader can realize a finite price/margin windfall before substitute supply or restarts normalize the market.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Safety inspections and concentrated capacity can keep near-term supply tight, but alternative supply/restarts make this explicitly finite rather than structural.
disconfirmingEvidence: Longsheng had already rerated sharply before cutoff.
The exact persistence of the outage and downstream demand response were uncertain.
A pre-event earnings baseline is stale and therefore only a conservative reference, not current consensus.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Major accident and immediate supply disruption occurred before cutoff.
Intermediate prices and producer quotations repriced sharply after the accident.
Specialist contemporaneous evidence supported broader dye/intermediate supply tightness.
Longsheng entered the event with strong realized 2018 earnings.
Auditable pre-event 2019 earnings baseline for expectation-burden arithmetic.
Capacity, price and earnings-sensitivity evidence arrived after the accident and before cutoff.
Price absorption was already very high by cutoff and must be explicitly overcome.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The opportunity basket was already strongly rerated: +25.30pp 20d and +20.78pp 60d excess with full breadth; Longsheng itself had +46.70pp 20d excess.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The market rerating is large, but the post-accident physical price jump and sellable capacity create an incremental near-term earnings bridge that can still matter over the next 20 trading days.
expectations.measurableGap: Using the published pre-event 2019 EPS baseline of RMB1.412 and the March 28 observed price near RMB16.47 implies roughly 11.7x baseline 2019E earnings before crediting the accident windfall. The new sensitivity is therefore large enough to preserve a credible—but not wide—base-horizon gap after the rerating.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Observed March 28 price versus a frozen pre-event 2019 EPS baseline, plus explicit incremental net-profit sensitivity from the accident.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: Pre-event published 2019 net-profit/EPS baseline was RMB4.593bn/RMB1.412; March 28 observed price was about RMB16.47 after three limit-up days in four sessions.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Only a portion of the quoted m-phenylenediamine price shock needs to persist through early Q2 to lift near-term earnings above the frozen baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Realized price/margin uplift must survive long enough to offset the already-large stock rerating; no long-run permanent scarcity is assumed.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Quoted prices collapse before shipments, or volume/cost effects offset the incremental margin.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Price realization, company operating updates and the next reporting cycle arrive inside the 20-day base/re-underwrite horizon.

earningsConversionBridge.nextObservableMetric: realized intermediate/dye selling prices, sales volume and the next company operating/reporting update
earningsConversionBridge.failureCondition: Quoted prices fail to convert to realized shipments or reverse materially before the first re-underwrite.

thesisPath.mechanism: Finite supply shock raises realized price before normalization.

freshIncrementalEvidence.rationale: The accident, capacity loss and measured product-price shock were new information arriving within the final trading week.

baseHorizonConvexityTest.exitDiscipline: Re-underwrite no later than 20 trading days. Do not carry the supply-shock thesis beyond that point without a new frozen memo showing realized price/volume persistence.
baseHorizonConvexityTest.falsifier: By the re-underwrite point, realized prices/shipments do not support a material incremental earnings bridge or the price shock has normalized.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: Short-horizon Primary only: extreme price absorption is accepted solely because a fresh, quantitatively bridged physical earnings shock arrived after the old earnings baseline and the validity horizon is capped at 20 trading days.

bearCase: The market capitalizes a transient quoted-price spike faster than Longsheng can realize shipments; normalization begins before the earnings bridge is recognized.

invalidationConditions.threshold: no measurable earnings conversion by 20 trading days

caveats: Selection is frozen before post-cutoff outcomes.
